Pose - Mid-Stride.name: Pose - Mid-Stride
Pose - Mid-Stride.description:
🕴️ Pose: Mid-Stride
Captured in the middle of walking — one foot forward, body angled, suggesting motion and purpose.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Mid-Stride.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, show a natural mid-stride weight shift with the torso angled slightly forward and frame-visible arms moving in walking opposition. Do not reveal legs or ground outside the selected crop. Female: the hips lead the shift and the shoulders counter. Male: the shoulders drive the shift and the hips follow. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own gait.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
